sourcePolicy: Static imports of only the two actual public recording-derived JSON files. No private brain, user notes, archived drafts or remote fetches.
behavior: Matching podcast surface must be present in current requested-scope published rows before any transcript contribution is indexed
Enriches the existing podcast destination at its actual anchor; creates no extra destination or duplicate full-page record
Transcript text bounded to64000 characters per recording; both current full transcripts fit, including their final passages
Grounded chapter titles enrich tags; actual spoken text is searchable as body content
Always labels indexed text as machine-generated and not an official transcript
Preserves original published surface revision evidence and adds a distinct transcript/chapter payload hash
Scope cache key includes supplement fingerprints and is recalculated after current-publication checks; withdrawals remove transcript terms immediately

covered: Recording-derived sustainability query finds exact podcast anchor in both scopes
Original revision evidence retained plus machine-transcript hash
Withdrawal after cached read removes result
One DHS scoped recording not injected into empty DSD scope

limits: Keyword relevance scoring remains the existing program search policy; not every incidental word warrants a recommendation.
This is transcript-aware podcast discovery, not certified transcript fidelity or current-policy verification.
Final full app lint/typecheck/build and browser ASK verification owned by root/DSD agent.

downstreamEvidenceReview.sourceIdHandling: EvidenceRevision sourceId is an opaque schema-validated descriptor. Revalidation uses the current scoped document identity and all revisions/content hashes; it does not resolve each descriptor as an editable surface ID.
downstreamEvidenceReview.journalLimit: Historical journal validation preserves the recorded snapshot. Current publication eligibility is separately rechecked by current-source evidence validation; journal persistence is not permission to expose a withdrawn source as current.
